info.title: HealthBridge API
info.description: REST API over the HealthBridge transformation engine. Base path `/api/v1`; uploads are raw bytes, everything else is JSON. Every failure uses one envelope (`ErrorEnvelope`) with a stable `ErrorCode`. Engine and trace-protocol versions are runtime values — see `GET /version`.

post.description:
Creates the first workspace with the operator-held bootstrap token (`x-bootstrap-token`). The token is platform-level: it cannot read tenant data and is the only way to add a tenant. Returns the workspace and its owner key; the plaintext key is shown exactly once. Attempts are rate limited per client IP.

Requires the operator-held `x-bootstrap-token`, not an API key.

201.description: The created workspace and its owner key (plaintext, shown once).

key.description: Plaintext key (`hb_…`). Store it now: it cannot be retrieved again.

parameters.name: x-bootstrap-token
parameters.description: Operator-held bootstrap token (minimum 16 characters).

get.summary: Describe the current workspace and key
get.description:
Returns the workspace identified by the caller's key plus the key metadata (never the secret).

Requires scope `runs:read`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key (`hb_…`). Tenant isolation comes from the key, never the URL.

delete.description:
Owner-only. Requires the workspace slug in `confirm`. Soft-deletes the workspace, revokes every API key in it and schedules a hard purge (`workspace_purges`) after the configured grace period (`HEALTHBRIDGE_WORKSPACE_GRACE_DAYS`, default 7). Data stays readable to operators during the grace period; the retention sweep then deletes the workspace and every tenant row, keeping a platform audit record of the purge. A wrong slug returns 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` and changes nothing.

Requires scope `workspaces:admin`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

200.description: Deletion receipt with the scheduled purge time and revoked-key count.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key (`hb_…`). Tenant isolation comes from the key, never the URL.

post.description:
Issues a key for the caller's workspace. The plaintext is returned exactly once; every other response carries the prefix and metadata. `role` defaults to `viewer`. Unknown scope names are rejected with `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

Requires scope `workspaces:admin`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

post.description:
Uploads a file as the raw request body (any content type; hospital exports are routinely mislabelled). Objects are content-addressed by SHA-256, so identical bytes are stored once; the metadata row is tenant-scoped. Detection fills in `sourceFormat`/`domain` honestly — an unknown format stays `unknown`. `filename` may be a query parameter or the `x-filename` header.

Requires scope `assets:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

201.description: The stored asset with checksum and detection result.

parameters.description: File name (max 255 characters). Defaults to `upload.bin`.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Override the detected domain.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Override the detected source format.

parameters.name: x-filename
parameters.description: Alternative to the `filename` query parameter.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key (`hb_…`). Tenant isolation comes from the key, never the URL.

requestBody.description: The file bytes (`application/octet-stream` or the file's own type). Must be non-empty.

Hard-deletes the asset metadata row. Refused with 409 `CONFLICT` while any run in the workspace still references the asset — delete or retain those runs first. The content-addressed object is deleted only when no asset in any workspace still references the same bytes, so shared uploads survive another tenant's deletion.

Requires scope `assets:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

get.description:
Re-inspects the stored bytes with the adapter registry and returns the adapter's field summary. A foreign id reads as 404, never 403. An asset no registered adapter accepts returns `supported: false` with a null schema (plus the detection recorded at upload) instead of an error.

Requires scope `assets:read`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

post.description:
Runs are created with 202 plus a run resource, never as a synchronous transform. The row is written before the job is persisted, so 202 always means a job exists. Allowed `options`: `maxRecords`, `importedAt` (ISO-8601 reproducibility anchor), `adapterId`, `pipelineVersion`. Anything else is rejected with `VALIDATION_FAILED`. If the worker queue refuses the job, the call returns 503 and the run is recorded as failed with `error.code = QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Requires scope `runs:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

202.description: The queued run, whether it was created now, and links to follow it.

created.description: False when the Idempotency-Key replayed an earlier request.

parameters.name: idempotency-key

delete.description:
Hard-deletes a terminal run (`completed`, `completed_with_warnings`, `failed`, `cancelled`) together with its traces, resource index and queued job rows. Idempotency keys that created the run are freed, so the same key can create a new run afterwards. A live run returns 409 `RUN_NOT_TERMINAL`: cancel it first.

Requires scope `runs:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

post.description:
Cancellation is cooperative: an in-flight record finishes before the run stops, at stage boundaries. A run that already finished returns 409 `RUN_NOT_CANCELLABLE`; a row that changed or disappeared between read and write returns 409 `CONFLICT` / 404.

Requires scope `runs:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

post.summary: Pause a live run after its current chunk
post.description:
Cooperative pause — not a cancel. The worker finishes its in-flight record chunk, persists a checkpoint (`stage` + next `recordIndex` + input/output checksums) on the run row, and holds its queue slot with status `running` and `progress.stage: paused`. `POST /runs/:id/resume` continues it; cancelling a paused run aborts it and drops the checkpoint. Pause handles are process-local (demo mode): only the replica running the job observes the request, at its next chunk boundary. A run that already finished, is cancelling, or is already paused returns 409 `CONFLICT`. Static replay (`POST /runs/:id/replay`) is a separate path and is never labelled live.

Requires scope `runs:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

200.description: The pausing run plus its latest checkpoint, when one has been persisted yet.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Opaque resource id. Scoped to the workspace; a foreign id reads as 404, never 403.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key (`hb_…`). Tenant isolation comes from the key, never the URL.

post.summary: Resume a paused live run from its checkpoint
post.description:
Continues a paused run from its persisted checkpoint with byte-identical output to an uninterrupted run. Resume is cooperative like pause: the worker continues at its next scheduling turn. A run that is not paused — including finished runs, and cancelled runs, which do not keep a checkpoint — returns 409 `CONFLICT`.

Requires scope `runs:write`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

200.description: The resuming run plus the checkpoint it continues from.

parameters.name: id

get.description:
Server-sent events for one run (`Accept: text/event-stream`). The stream sends the current snapshot first, so a client that connects late (or reconnects) is never blind, then forwards queue events and closes on a terminal state. Event types: `snapshot`, `queued`, `started`, `progress`, `warning`, `done`, `error`, `cancelled`, plus `ping` heartbeats. A terminal event is always sent, even to a late subscriber.

Requires scope `runs:read`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

200.description: Event stream ending in a terminal event.

get.description:
Append-only audit trail, tenant scoped. Owner-only: the trail names actors. Records workspace creation, key issue/rotate/revoke, asset upload, mapping and pipeline creation, run creation, cancellation and replay. An audit write failure is logged, never allowed to break the request.

Requires scope `audit:read`. A key without it gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`.

BootstrapToken.description: Operator-held bootstrap token for workspace provisioning only.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; documented per operation.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Never contains SQL, paths or stacks.

requestId.description: Echo this when reporting the failure.

keyPrefix.description: Identifying prefix; the secret itself is never returned.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the bytes (`sha256:…`). Matches the `x-checksum` header.

domain.description: Detected domain, or `unknown` when detection found nothing.

id.description: Mapping id (`mp_…`). Runs reference this, never the name.

name.description: Slug; posting an existing name creates the next version.

config.description: Engine options applied at run creation.

Run.description: Full run row, including options, summary, validation and engine versions.

error.description: Failure detail; present when the run failed.

RunBundle.description: Self-describing replay descriptor. Never embeds payload bytes.

mapping.description: The mapping spec version the run executed.

expected.description: Checksums and counts a reproduction must match.

RunCheckpoint.description: Persisted resume cursor for a live run: the pipeline stage, the next record index, and the checksums that bind the checkpoint to one exact input and output prefix.

stage.description: Pipeline stage the checkpoint was taken at.

recordIndex.description: Zero-based index of the next record to process.

recordsProcessed.description: Records processed when the checkpoint was taken.

inputChecksum.description: Checksum of the run input; a resume with different bytes is refused.

outputChecksumSoFar.description: Checksum of the output prefix produced so far.

importedAt.description: Effective provenance timestamp; a resume must reuse it for byte-identical output.

action.description: One of `workspace.created`, `workspace.deletion_requested`, `key.issued`, `key.revoked`, `key.rotated`, `asset.uploaded`, `asset.deleted`, `mapping.created`, `pipeline.created`, `run.created`, `run.cancelled`, `run.deleted`, `run.replayed`, `retention.swept`. Workspace purges are recorded in the platform audit (`workspace.purged`), not the tenant trail.

limits.description: Authoritative limits; clients must read these instead of hard-coding maximums.
